analysis.title: Bitwise Crypto Market Review Q4 2026
key_insights: Q3 2026 was one of crypto's best quarters. The Bitwise 10 Large Cap Crypto Index rose 46.39%, with all ten constituents posting double-digit gains, after Q2 sentiment described as among the worst on record.
Bitcoin rose past $83,000 after a June low of $59,000. Ethereum +69%, Solana +59%, Chainlink +99%, NEAR +175% and Zcash +255% in the quarter.
Spot bitcoin ETFs took in roughly $6B in Q3, including $3.5B in August (best month of 2026), flipping year-to-date net flows positive in late September after record Q2 outflows.
Bitcoin rallied despite the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 (25 bps on September 16). Inflation is 3.4% and the 10-year Treasury yield is above 5.2%, and investors expect more hikes into year-end.

Federal debt topped $40T in August. Treasury Secretary Bessent intervened in the bond market, which investors read as quantitative easing and pushed bitcoin higher. Bitwise expects both the rate and debasement forces to persist into Q4.

The CLARITY Act market-structure bill failed to reach the 60 Senate votes needed and is unlikely to move this year. The SEC and CFTC are pursuing pro-crypto rulemaking on tokenized stocks, ICO-style fundraising, security classification and derivatives instead.

Polymarket puts the odds of a Democratic sweep in the November midterms above 60%. Bitwise says a Democratic or split Congress would slow crypto legislation and could bring tougher oversight of the SEC, CFTC and Trump-affiliated crypto projects, but says it cannot fundamentally alter the regulatory path of the two regulators. It expects some volatility around the midterms.

The SEC's September 17 innovation exemption lets tokenized U.S.-listed stocks trade onchain with restrictions. DTCC plans to launch its tokenization service in October. Bitwise expects Q4 to move tokenization from pilots to production.

Tokenized stock value rose 65.5% in Q3 to an all-time high near $3.2B as Robinhood, Coinbase and others entered. Robinhood launched its own Ethereum layer 2 on July 1, drawing about $94B in onchain trading volume.

Open interest on decentralized perps exchanges hit a record of about $26B, with a growing share in stocks, commodities, FX and pre-IPO shares. More than $6T of perps traded year to date, up 42% from the same period last year.

The CFTC approved the first U.S. bitcoin perps in May and has begun writing formal perp rules, with two proposals under White House review. Bitwise projects the perp market accelerates as U.S. investors arrive.
Privacy assets led the quarter: Zcash +249%, Monero +72%, NEAR +186%, Venice +108%.

Bitcoin's share of the crypto market fell below 60% for the first time this year (the report's table shows 63.35% of the $2,651B total at September 30). Revenue-generating protocols led: Pump.fun +289%, Ethena +233%, Raydium +213%, Uniswap +207%.
Crypto lost more than $1.25B across 116 hack incidents in Q3, the worst quarter of 2026, including Bitget ($387M) and Coldcard ($116M).
Solana's first binding governance vote moves the 1.5% inflation floor forward to 2029 from 2032, removing about 19 million SOL from future supply.
U.S. spot ETPs and public companies bought 4.1x the new bitcoin produced since spot ETPs launched in January 2024 (2,014,553 BTC demand vs 496,756 BTC new supply).

Year to date through September 30, the Bitwise 10 Large Cap Crypto Index is -6.21% while the Crypto Innovators 30 equity index is +27.94%, commodities +45.60% and U.S. equities +12.75%. Hyperliquid is the YTD standout at +249.57%.
Bitwise's 60/40 portfolio analysis shows adding 5% bitcoin lifted annualized return from 7.19% to 11.10% and Sharpe from 0.534 to 0.879, with maximum drawdown rising from 22.17% to 25.45%.
Bitcoin's 90-day correlation is 0.40 with U.S. equities and 0.52 with gold. The Bitwise 10 index correlation with U.S. equities is 0.42.
Public companies hold 1.29M BTC (6.14% of supply, valued at $106B). Strategy holds 847,666 BTC. Net purchases were only 6,441 BTC in Q3, and the count of holding companies fell 5.98% QoQ to 173.
Public ETH treasuries hold 7.97M ETH (6.52% of supply, $21.3B), with 231,845 net ETH purchased in Q3. BitMine holds 6,001,302 ETH.
Spot ETP assets under management at September 30: bitcoin $108.0B (net flows since launch $59.5B), Ethereum $17.6B, Solana $1.6B, XRP $1.7B, Hyperliquid $483M.
Kalshi leads prediction-market volume in most categories (65.4% of sports at $33.5B, 87.6% of crypto), while Polymarket leads politics at 70.4%.
Top crypto applications by 12-month revenue: Hyperliquid $685.8M, Pump.fun $465.0M, Axiom $207.8M, Sky $201.4M.

market_movers.rationale: Bitcoin up 42.31% in Q3 to above $83,000 but still -4.55% YTD. Bitwise sees a bottom after the June low of $59,000.
Hyperliquid is +249.57% YTD, the top 10-index performer. It leads application revenue at $685.8M over 12 months, and spot ETP assets reached $483M.
Coinbase is +27.51% in Q3 but -17.57% YTD, and it launched tokenized stocks for non-U.S. investors in Q3.
Strategy is +76.11% in Q3 and +0.75% YTD, with 847,666 BTC held.

sector_views.rationale: The Crypto Innovators 30 index is +27.94% YTD against -6.21% for the large-cap crypto index. Bitwise's portfolio analysis shows a 5% allocation adding return with a 95.42% win rate over rolling 3-year windows.

macro_indicators.reading: 25 bps hike on September 16, first since 2023
macro_indicators.interpretation: Bitwise says the table is set for further hikes that could pressure risk assets, though bitcoin rose through the first hike.
Higher yields raise debt-servicing concerns and pushed Treasury intervention that bitcoin traded as quantitative easing.
Debasement concern is a bullish force for bitcoin that offsets rate pressure.

crypto_views: Bitwise believes crypto bottomed in June at $59,000 for bitcoin and calls Q3 the start of a crypto spring.

Tokenization is expected to move from pilots to production in Q4 after the SEC's September 17 innovation exemption and DTCC's October service launch. Bitwise expects billions more of tokenized assets on Ethereum, Solana and NEAR.
U.S. perps are expected to grow once CFTC rules are finalized, with the first U.S. bitcoin perps approved in May.
Bitcoin dominance fell below 60% as money moved into revenue-generating altcoins such as Pump.fun, Ethena, Raydium and Uniswap.
Privacy assets (Zcash, Monero, NEAR, Venice) were among the best-performing themes of the quarter.
Bitcoin seasonality: the historical average for October is +25.18% and November +35.00%, while September averages -3.37%.
Spot ETP flows resumed: bitcoin about $6B in Q3, with Solana, XRP and Hyperliquid ETPs also holding net inflows since launch.
Tokenized stocks reached near $3.2B, and tokenized assets are growing across Solana, Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Robinhood's chain.
risk_factors: Further Fed hikes with inflation at 3.4% and the 10-year yield above 5.2% could pressure risk assets.
A Democratic or split Congress after the November midterms could slow crypto legislation and tighten oversight of the SEC, CFTC and Trump-affiliated crypto projects.
The CLARITY Act failed in the Senate and is unlikely to advance this year.
Q3 hacks were the worst of 2026: more than $1.25B lost across 116 incidents.
Treasury intervention and debt concerns introduce bond-market instability.
Public bitcoin treasury buying slowed, with the holder count down 5.98% QoQ.
vol_and_positioning: Perp open interest on decentralized exchanges is a record of about $26B, with growing shares in equities, commodities, FX and pre-IPO names.
Public companies hold 1.29M BTC (6.14% of supply) but made only 6,441 net BTC purchases in Q3, and the holder count fell 5.98% QoQ to 173.
Bitcoin 90-day rolling correlation: 0.40 to U.S. equities, 0.52 to gold, 0.68 to the Crypto Innovators 30 index.
Bitwise expects volatility around the November midterms.
geopolitical: Polymarket odds of a Democratic sweep in the November U.S. midterms above 60%, with possible slowdown of crypto legislation and tougher oversight of the SEC, CFTC and Trump-affiliated crypto projects.

tension_points.bull_case: Federal debt above $40T and Treasury intervention in the bond market, which investors viewed as quantitative easing, pushed bitcoin higher. Bitwise expects this force to persist into Q4.
tension_points.bear_case: The Fed hiked 25 bps on September 16 with inflation at 3.4% and the 10-year yield above 5.2%, setting the table for further hikes that could pressure risk assets.

tension_points.bull_case: There is little a Democrat-led Congress can do to alter the pro-crypto regulatory path of the SEC and CFTC, and the agencies are pushing rules on tokenized stocks, derivatives and security classification.
tension_points.bear_case: Polymarket odds of a Democratic sweep above 60% imply a Congress that could slow or kill crypto legislation and bring tougher oversight of the SEC, CFTC and Trump-affiliated crypto projects.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The November U.S. midterm result, with a Democratic sweep or split Congress the bearish outcome for legislation.

theme_stances.evidence: We believe Q4 moves tokenization from pilots to production.

theme_stances.evidence: we project the growing perp market to accelerate as U.S. investors start to arrive.
